facts.fact: Le Sahel reports that the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy launched work to elaborate a digital policy 'Niger Numérique 2021-2030', with a national technical committee preparing a draft to submit to the Government for adoption; the article date (July 2020) is used.
The policy being drafted is named 'Niger Numérique 2021-2030' and covers 2021-2030, as reported by Le Sahel in July 2020.
